_comment: The agent's own SSH server, neutrino_ssh_server under bin/ of the agent's program directory, built for each platform below. Its settings, config/devices/<id>/ssh_server.json, name the enabled accounts, each with the private half of the key the hub made for it; the agent runs one instance per enabled account on 127.0.0.1, admitting that key alone.
name: ssh_server
title: SSH server
description: Lets every program that speaks SSH reach this machine's enabled accounts
